 Order

The petitioners have been granted interim anticipatory bail in connection with FIR No. 102/2023 for offences under Sections 376, 354, 504, 506, 34 of IPC registered with Police Station, Khour, District Jammu.
The said order is still subsisting and during the pendency of this bail application, investigation of the case has progressed substantially.

In fact, on 04.04.2025, when the matter was taken up for consideration, upon perusal of the case diary, it was noted by this Court that the investigation of the case has reached a crucial stage and guidance was being sought by the Page |2 C/w investigating agency from the Prosecution Wing regarding further course of action.
On 11.03.2025 when the case diary was perused by this Court it was noted that the involvement of petitioner No. 2 to 5 has not been established.
It was further submitted by the Investigating officer that the petitioners are cooperating with the investigation of the case.
